$comment: Per-skill settings for scripts/test-skill-examples.sh; format in README ('Skill example tests'). Paths are relative to the repository root. Repo-controlled skills (repo-owned, or vendored with a patch in patches/) use mode enforce; vendored skills without a patch use mode report (fixes go through patches/, never through edits). Every skip and shellcheck exclusion needs a reason.

shellcheck.reason: Snippets are fragments: they assign variables that later text uses (SC2034), use variables set elsewhere (SC2154) and source files that do not exist in the test directory (SC1091).

plugins/powershell/skills/pester/SKILL.m.$comment: Vendored from github/awesome-copilot with patches/pester.patch, so repo-controlled: a failing example is fixed in the patch.

allowed_skips.reason: Windows-only example on a non-Windows host

plugins/powershell/skills/powershell-saf.$comment: PowerShell: native-command invocation, quoting and Start-Process examples (parsed only; they would start processes).

plugins/dotnet/skills/setup-local-sdk/SK.$comment: Complete bash and PowerShell install scripts plus global.json.

plugins/csharp-patterns/skills/dotnet-pr.$comment: GitHub Actions YAML, PowerShell build helpers, JSON config, bash.

plugins/csharp-patterns/skills/testconta.$comment: GitHub Actions YAML for integration tests with containers.

plugins/anthropic-skills/skills/webapp-t.$comment: Python (Playwright) and bash; compiled, not run (needs a browser and a web server).

plugins/anthropic-skills/skills/skill-cr.$comment: JSON formats (evals, grading, benchmark) and bash commands for writing skills.
